trust_decision.summary: LiveComponentHydrator accepts client-returned props / propsFromParent blobs as server-authored if HMAC(json_encode(sorted data)) matches; the MAC covers only the data, not which component or which slot it was minted for.

landing_point.why: Summary names LiveComponentHydrator's HMAC checksum; calculateChecksum is the only hash_hmac in the class and the single primitive both sign and verify use.

fix_sites.entry_point: dehydrate() on every render: LiveControllerAttributesCreator (initial HTML data-live-props-value), Twig component_url, LiveUrlSubscriber, TestLiveComponent
public method addChecksumToData, called by ChildComponentPartialRenderer during parent re-render
calculateChecksum (private primitive shared by sign and verify)
combineAndValidateProps: props slot (772) and propsFromParent slot (778)
parent component re-render (InterceptChildComponentRenderSubscriber) minting propsFromParent blob for a child

O3_reason_to_dismiss: addChecksumToData looks like a generic helper used only for child re-render bookkeeping, so a solver could bind only dehydrate/props and leave the propsFromParent producer and slot unbound; however a signature change forces it via ArgumentCountError and existing child-render tests break if sign/verify disagree.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate parent->child propsFromParent updates (blob minted by ChildComponentPartialRenderer for the child's canonical name) and component lookup by FQCN alias must keep verifying; binding to the raw route string or rejecting all propsFromParent breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: props blob from POST body data.props (src/LiveComponent/src/EventListener/LiveComponentSubscriber.php:224-230)
props blob from GET query ?props= for method:get components (src/LiveComponent/src/EventListener/LiveComponentSubscriber.php:213-215)
propsFromParent blob in body or query (src/LiveComponent/src/EventListener/LiveComponentSubscriber.php:220,235)
blob replayed across components (component binding) and across slots props<->propsFromParent (slot binding) (fix.diff:89-91)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second HMAC signer (same secret) whose output gets trusted as a props/propsFromParent checksum without name/slot binding.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: FingerprintCalculator already HMACs child input props with the same secret for parent->child bookkeeping; a maintainer could plausibly reuse it to sign the child's propsFromParent payload.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A batch/deferred hydration path that verifies via a separate unbound checksum helper rather than combineAndValidateProps.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _batch already has a distinct hydration route setting _mounted_component; a dedicated helper there is a natural refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Real code at distance with the identical unbound pre-image, '@checksum' key and default %kernel.secret%; could be modelled as a planted second implementation in a copy.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already exists in another package; the identical form shows maintainers wrote it this way twice.

O9_family: CWE-345 insufficient verification of data authenticity: MAC lacking context/domain binding (cross-component and cross-slot replay)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >=8.1, composer, phpunit (symfony/phpunit-bridge), per-package composer install in src/LiveComponent

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Bind only the component name into calculateChecksum for the props slot (or use the raw route _live_component string), leaving propsFromParent slot binding / ChildComponentPartialRenderer producer unbound.

out_of_scope_notes: Autocomplete ChecksumCalculator (src/Autocomplete/src/Checksum/ChecksumCalculator.php:25) uses the identical unbound HMAC(json_encode(sorted)) pre-image, the same '@checksum' key and default %kernel.secret% (src/Autocomplete/src/DependencyInjection/AutocompleteExtension.php:136, src/LiveComponent/src/DependencyInjection/LiveComponentExtension.php:306); it is not bound to the autocompleter alias. Separate package and protection, not pursued; the published fix's name/slot prefix incidentally domain-separates LiveComponent MACs from it.
